IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key reused with the byte-equivalent request for ambiguous acceptance replay.

EventStream.description: UTF-8 SSE stream. Every message MUST contain exactly one decimal `id` equal to the JSON event `sequence`, and one `data` field containing that complete Agent FAI Event JSON object. Heartbeats are comments and do not advance sequence.
